title: Email links not working
creator: eightfarthings
content:
I receive "daily digest" emails from groups.io. They contain links to individual topics within the digest that provide a quick way to select messages I want to read while skipping the rest.

These links do not work in Thunderbird for Android (they do work in other email readers). Links to external sites do work just fine.

Can this be fixed?
